newsitem.title: DENMARK: BG Bank 96 result gets mixed reception.
newsitem.headline: BG Bank 96 result gets mixed reception.

text.p: Analysts on Monday described BG Bank's 1996 result as close to expectations but expressed concern about the dramatic fall in securities and foreign exchange profits.
"Such a major drop in securities and foreign exchange earnings is is not good for a year like 1996," one dealer told Reuters.
BG Bank securities and forex results for 1996 halved to 414 million crowns from the previous year's 884 million crowns and compared to analysts' expectations of an average 671 million crown profit.
But despite the concern, the BG Bank share fell only a relatively modest 1.6 percent or five crowns to 300 after the announcement of the 1996 result and was still at that level at 1235 gmt.
"BG's overall result was nonetheless close to market expectations, which were probably a little on the optimistic side anyway," another dealer said.

BG Bank, Denmark's third biggest banking group, formed in January 1996 from a merger of the post office Girobank and Bikuben savings bank, posted 1996 profits before tax and extraordinary items of 1.938 billion crowns.
The result compared with a 1.885 billion crown surplus in 1995 and average analyst expectations of 1.972 billion crowns.
